picks.analysis: The Panthers have a solid roster and home-field advantage in this matchup. With the Cardinals struggling in recent preseason games, the Panthers should cover the spread comfortably.
Both teams have shown offensive potential in the preseason, suggesting a high-scoring game. The total set at 35.5 is quite achievable given their offensive capabilities.
The Cardinals may surprise with an upset given their underdog status. If their starters perform well, they could steal a win on the road.
The Panthers are expected to dominate this matchup, especially with key players likely seeing more time. A spread of -3.5 is a reasonable expectation for their performance.
While both teams have potential, preseason games often see limited scoring as teams evaluate their rosters. The under may hit if both teams play conservatively.
